Title: Prohibits judges from using fabricated legal authority in adjudicative writings
Summary: Provides that judges who knowingly or recklessly use fabricated legal authority in adjudicative writings shall be guilty of misconduct in office and conduct prejudicial to the administration of justice; defines terms; authorizes the state commission on judicial conduct to refer a determination of misconduct to the assembly for impeachment.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the judiciary law, in relation to prohibiting judges from using fabricated legal authority in adjudicative writings
